deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

entry_route.value: The graduate school sets 72 hours for a PhD after a bachelor's and 42 after a master's, so both routes are open.
entry_route.quote: Students who do not hold a master’s degree will be required to complete a minimum of seventy-two hours of graduate credit

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog states no funding policy.

notes: Ceramic Engineering and Metallurgical Engineering PhD pages (catalog) have no GRE or English rule. The catalog page has no admission rule beyond the university record.
